propositions: Every verification index in Pass-2 is rejected as unexpected when the Pass-1 finding list is empty, causing all findings to degrade to INDETERMINATE despite correct PASS verdict.
The verify kernel sends an empty index domain for zero findings but receives indices 0..N-1 from the model, creating a contract violation due to mismatch between sent and returned index sets.
Empty finding batches trigger verify_instructions() to return 'Emit one verification per finding' with no findings listed, instructing the model to emit verifications for an impossible condition.
INDETERMINATE findings cannot cause a BLOCK decision; degraded findings are silently absorbed and the verdict remains PASS if any advisory surfaces, masking the verification failure.
The fix replaces the defective instruction string with EMPTY_BATCH_INSTRUCTIONS for empty batches, mirroring the prerequisite workflow contract and eliminating the index-basis mismatch.
